title: HCT 與細胞治療的統計方法

blocks.en: © The Author(s) 2024 A. Sureda et al. (eds.), The EBMT Handbook, https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-44080-9_6 6Statistical Methods in HCT and Cellular Therapies Simona Iacobelli and Liesbeth C. de Wreede 6.1 Introduction The analysis of data describing the outcomes of patients who have received an HCT is not only fundamental to assessing the effectiveness of the treatment but can provide invaluable information on the prognostic role of disease and patient factors. Thus, the appropriate analysis and understanding of such data are of paramount importance. This document provides an overview of the main and well-established statistical methods, as well as a brief introduction of more novel techniques. More insight is provided in the EBMT Statistical Guidelines (Iacobelli 2013).
blocks.zh: 【第6章：HCT 與細胞治療的統計方法】作者：Simona Iacobelli、Liesbeth C. de Wreede。© 作者，2024；收錄於 A. Sureda 等編《The EBMT Handbook》，章節 DOI：https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-44080-9_6。〔6.1 導論〕分析接受 HCT 患者的治療結果，不僅是評估治療有效性的基礎，也能提供疾病與病人因素之預後角色的重要資訊。因此，適當分析並理解這類資料極為重要。本章概述主要且已充分建立的統計方法，並簡介較新的技術。更深入的內容可參考《EBMT Statistical Guidelines》（Iacobelli，2013）。

blocks.en: Additionally, the paper by de Wreede et al. (2022) explains the most important concepts and related pitfalls in the analysis of HCT studies.
blocks.zh: 此外，de Wreede 等（2022）的論文，也說明了分析 HCT 研究時最重要的概念及相關陷阱。

blocks.en: 6.2 Endpoints The outcomes most commonly studied in HCT analyses are the key events occurring at varying times post-HCT, e.g. engraftment, GVHD, relapse/progression and death. Besides the clinical definition of the event of interest, it is important to define the corresponding statistical endpoint and to use a proper method of measuring the occurrence of the event (Guidelines 2.1).
blocks.zh: 〔6.2 終點 Endpoints〕HCT 分析最常研究的結果，是移植後不同時間發生的重要事件，例如植入、GVHD、復發／疾病進展與死亡。除了定義研究事件的臨床意義，也必須定義對應的統計終點，並使用適當方法衡量事件發生情形（指引第2.1節）。

blocks.en: The main distinction is between events that occur with certainty during a sufficiently long observation period (follow-up), death in particular and events which are precluded from occurring once another event occurs, e.g. not all patients will experience a relapse of their disease because some die before. We define death without prior relapse (usually called NRM; see Guidelines 2.1.2) as the ‘competing event’ of relapse. The name ‘NRM’ is preferable to TRM, the proper analysis of which requires individual adjudication of causes of death.
blocks.zh: 主要區別在於：某些事件在觀察時間夠長時終究會發生，尤其是死亡；另一些事件則可能被其他事件阻止，例如並非所有患者都會疾病復發，因為有些患者先死亡。我們將「尚未復發便死亡」定義為復發的競爭事件，通常稱為 NRM（見指引第2.1.2節）。NRM 這個名稱優於 TRM，因為若要正確分析 TRM，必須逐一判定死亡原因。

blocks.en: Standard survival endpoints: In addition to death, other examples of events of the first type are the combinations of (negative) events of interest, which in total have 100% probability of occurrence, for example, PFS which considers as failure the event ‘either relapse/progression or death, whatever occurs first’. The components of PFS are the two competing events mentioned above, relapse/progression and NRM.
blocks.zh: 【標準存活終點】除了死亡以外，第一類事件還包括由數個不良事件組合成的終點，合計而言其發生機率為 100%。例如 PFS 將「復發／進展或死亡，何者先發生」視為失敗事件。PFS 的兩個組成部分，就是前述互為競爭事件的復發／進展與 NRM。

blocks.en: Competing risks endpoints: In addition to relapse/progression and NRM, other examples are death of a specific cause and all intermediate events during an HCT history (engraftment, GVHD, achievement of CR, CMV infection) including the long term (diagnosis of secondary malignancy). Notice that the definition of an endpoint requires specifying which are the competing events. Usually, this will be death without prior event of interest, but depending on the disease and the aims of the analysis, other competing events might be included in the analysis, e.g. a second transplantation or other treatment can be considered as competing event for achievement of response.
blocks.zh: 【競爭風險終點】除了復發／進展與 NRM，其他例子還包括特定死因的死亡，以及 HCT 病程中的中間事件，例如植入、GVHD、達到完全緩解（CR）、CMV 感染，及長期事件，例如第二惡性腫瘤的診斷。定義一個終點時，必須同時明確指出其競爭事件。通常是「在研究事件發生前死亡」，但也可依疾病與分析目的納入其他競爭事件；例如評估達到治療反應時，可將第二次移植或其他治療視為競爭事件。

blocks.en: 6.3 Analysis of Time-to-Event Outcomes Each event of interest may occur at variable times posttransplant, so in statistical terms, it has two components—whether it occurs at all and, if it does, when. However, at the end of the follow-up, there can be patients who have not yet had the event of interest but are still at risk for it: their observation times are called ‘censored’. Censoring occurs at different timepoints for different patients. The inclusion of censored data precludes the use of simple statistical methods such as the chi-square or T-test and requires the methods of survival (or competing risks) analysis. The crucial assumption of most methods in survival analysis is that the patients censored at a timepoint are ‘represented’ by those who remain under follow-up beyond that timepoint. In other words, the fact that a patient is censored should not indicate that their prognosis is worse or better than the prognosis of a similar patient who remains under observation.
blocks.zh: 〔6.3 至事件時間 Time-to-event 結果的分析〕研究事件可能在移植後不同時間發生，因此在統計上有兩個面向：事件究竟有沒有發生，以及若有發生，是在何時。然而，追蹤結束時，部分患者尚未發生研究事件，卻仍有未來發生的可能；這類觀察時間稱為「截尾」（censored）。不同患者在不同時間點被截尾。由於包含截尾資料，不能只使用卡方檢定或 t 檢定等簡單方法，而需要存活分析或競爭風險分析。多數存活分析方法的重要假設，是某時間點被截尾的患者，可由該時間點之後仍持續追蹤的患者來「代表」。換言之，截尾本身不應意味著該患者的預後，比條件相似但仍在觀察中的患者更差或更好。

blocks.en: This assumption is called ‘independent and uninformative’ censoring.
blocks.zh: 這個假設稱為「獨立且不具資訊性截尾」（independent and uninformative censoring）。

blocks.en: 6.3.1 Kaplan-Meier Curves The main method to summarize survival endpoints is the Kaplan-Meier curve (Kaplan and Meier 1958), estimating for each point in time t after HCT the probability S(t) of surviving beyond that time. This curve is decreasing from 100% and will reach 0% with complete followup. A long flat tail of the curve (often called ‘plateau’) is often based on a few censored observations at late times, corresponding to very unreliable estimates of the long-term survival. It is useful to report each S(t) with its 95%CI (confidence interval at 95% level, best obtained using the Greenwood formula) or at least the number of patients still at risk at different timepoints. The median survival time is the minimum time when S(t) is equal to 50% (Fig. 6.1).
blocks.zh: 〔6.3.1 Kaplan–Meier 曲線〕概述存活終點的主要方法，是 Kaplan–Meier 曲線（Kaplan 與 Meier，1958），用以估計 HCT 後每個時間點 t，存活超過該時間的機率 S(t)。原文描述這條曲線從 100% 向下遞減，並在完整追蹤下達到 0%。曲線尾端長而平坦的部分常被稱為「平台期」（plateau），但它往往僅由少數晚期截尾觀察值支撐，因此長期存活估計可能非常不可靠。報告每個 S(t) 時，最好同時提供其 95% 信賴區間（95% CI；可用 Greenwood 公式取得），至少也應列出不同時間點仍處於風險集的患者人數。中位存活時間，是 S(t) 達到 50% 的最早時間（圖6.1）。

blocks.en: 6.3.2 Cumulative Incidence Curves The appropriate method to summarize endpoints with competing risks is the cumulative incidence curve (Gooley et al. 1999), estimating for each point in time t the probability F(t) of having had the event of interest before that time. This curve is increasing from 0% and will not reach 100% even with complete follow-up if the competing event was observed for some patients. It is always useful to interpret cumulative incidence curves of competing events together, to understand, e.g. when a category of patients has a small risk of relapse, if this means that they have a good prognosis or that they died too early from complications to experience a relapse (shown by a high NRM curve) (Fig. 6.1).
blocks.zh: 〔6.3.2 累積發生率曲線〕概述具有競爭風險之終點的適當方法，是累積發生率曲線（Gooley 等，1999），用以估計每個時間點 t 之前，研究事件已發生的機率 F(t)。曲線由 0% 向上增加；若部分患者發生了競爭事件，即使完整追蹤，研究事件的累積發生率也不會達到 100%。一起解讀各競爭事件的累積發生率非常有用。例如某類患者的復發風險較低，究竟表示預後良好，還是因為他們太早死於併發症，來不及發生復發？後者會表現為較高的 NRM 曲線（圖6.1）。

blocks.en: 6.3.3 Comparison of Groups The main method to compare survival curves for two or more independent groups is the log-rank test. This test is based on the comparison of the underlying hazard functions, which express the instantaneous probability of the event at a time t among patients currently at risk. It has good properties in the situation of proportional hazards (PH, described in the next section), but it should be avoided (or considered carefully) when the survival curves cross; with converging curve alternatives like the Wilcoxon signed-rank test should be preferred.
blocks.zh: 〔6.3.3 組間比較〕比較兩組或更多獨立組別存活曲線的主要方法，是 log-rank test。此檢定比較其背後的 hazard functions，亦即時間 t 時，仍處於風險集之患者發生事件的瞬時風險。在 proportional hazards（PH；下節說明）成立時，這個檢定有良好性質；但當存活曲線交叉時，應避免使用，或審慎評估其適用性。原文另指出，對逐漸接近的曲線，宜優先考慮 Wilcoxon signed-rank test 等替代方法。
blocks.note: 翻譯註：這裡忠實保留原書「Wilcoxon signed-rank」的名稱，但 signed-rank 通常用於配對／單樣本資料；獨立組別的存活曲線比較不能直接套用配對檢定。請核對原引文與統計設計，勿將此句當作通用選法。

blocks.en: In the comparison of cumulative incidence curves, the main method is the Gray test. Also the log-rank test can be applied to compare groups in the case of competing risks, when the object of interest is not the cumulative probability of occurrence of the event but its instantaneous probability among the cases at risk at each time, which is called ‘cause-specific hazard’. For the interesting difference of the two approaches to the analysis of competing risks endpoints, see Dignam and Kocherginsky (2008).
blocks.zh: 比較累積發生率曲線的主要方法是 Gray test。競爭風險情境下，也可以用 log-rank test 比較組別，但此時關注的不是事件發生的累積機率，而是每個時間點仍在風險集中之個案的瞬時風險，稱為 cause-specific hazard。這兩種競爭風險分析途徑的差異，可參考 Dignam 與 Kocherginsky（2008）。

blocks.en: We refer to Sects. 1.3 and 1.4 of the guidelines for remarks on statistical testing and about proper settings for comparisons of groups. Importantly, the simple methods described in this chapter can be applied only to groups defined at or before the time origin (e.g. transplantation); assessing differences between groups defined during the follow- up requires other approaches, as those described in Sect. 6.4.1 (Guidelines page 14).
blocks.zh: 關於統計檢定及適當組間比較設計，請參考指引第1.3與1.4節。尤其需要注意，本章描述的簡單方法，只適用於時間起點（例如移植日）當時或之前即已定義的組別。若組別是在追蹤過程中才形成，評估其差異需要其他方法，例如第6.4.1節所述的方法（指引第14頁）。

blocks.en: 6.3.4 Proportional Hazard Regression Analysis The above tests do not give a summary measure of the difference in outcomes between groups, nor can they be used when the impact of a continuous risk factor (e.g. age) has to be assessed. Furthermore, any comparison could be affected by confounding. These limitations are typically overcome by applying a (multivariable) regression model. The one most commonly used for survival endpoints is the proportional hazard (PH) Cox model (Cox 1972). Results are provided in terms of hazard ratios (HR), which are assumed to be constant during the whole follow- up (Guidelines 4.3.1).
blocks.zh: 〔6.3.4 比例風險迴歸分析〕前述檢定不會提供組間結果差異的單一概括量，也無法直接評估年齡等連續風險因子的影響；此外，任何比較都可能受到混雜影響。這些限制通常可藉由多變項迴歸模型處理。存活終點最常使用的是 proportional hazards Cox model（Cox，1972）。結果以 hazard ratio（HR）表示，並假設 HR 在整段追蹤期間維持固定（指引第4.3.1節）。

blocks.en: The Cox model in its simplest form is thus not appropriate when a factor has an effect that strongly decreases (or increases) over time, but time-varying effects can be accommodated for in more complex models. Effects of characteristics which change during follow-up can be assessed by including them as time- dependent covariates.
blocks.zh: 因此，若某因素的效果會隨時間明顯減弱或增強，最簡單形式的 Cox model 並不適合；但較複雜的模型可容納隨時間改變的效果。若某項特徵本身會在追蹤中改變，則可將其納入為 time-dependent covariate，以評估其影響。

blocks.en: For endpoints with competing risks, two methods can be used, which have a different focus: the Cox model can be used to analyse cause-specific hazards, whereas a regression model for cumulative incidence curves was proposed by Fine and Gray (1999).
blocks.zh: 對具有競爭風險的終點，可使用兩種關注焦點不同的方法：Cox model 可分析 cause-specific hazards；Fine 與 Gray（1999）則提出用於累積發生率曲線的迴歸模型。

blocks.en: The use of these regression models requires a sound statistical knowledge, as there are many potential difficulties with the methods both in application and interpretation of results.
blocks.zh: 這些迴歸模型的應用與結果解讀，都可能遇到許多困難，因此使用者需要具備扎實的統計知識。

blocks.en: Fig. 6.1 Probability curves of the four main outcomes after HCT. CIR: cumulative incidence of relapse. CIR and NRM add up to 1-RFS. Number at risk indicates the number of patients in follow-up who have not yet experienced an event. The grey zones indicate 95% confidence intervals. Figure labels: Probability; Years since HCT; Overall Survival; Relapse-Free Survival; CIR; NRM; Number at risk.
blocks.zh: 【圖6.1】HCT 後四種主要結果的機率曲線。CIR 為復發累積發生率；CIR 與 NRM 相加等於 1−RFS。Number at risk 指仍持續追蹤且尚未發生事件的患者人數。灰色區域為 95% 信賴區間。圖內文字：Probability＝機率；Years since HCT＝HCT 後年數；Overall Survival＝整體存活；Relapse-Free Survival＝無復發存活；CIR＝復發累積發生率；NRM＝非復發死亡；Number at risk＝風險集人數。

blocks.en: 6.4 Advanced Methods Many more advanced methods than the ones described above exist that help to get more insights from the available data. A good application of these needs expert statistical knowledge.
blocks.zh: 〔6.4 進階方法〕除了前述方法，還有許多更進階的方法，可從現有資料取得更多見解。要正確應用這些方法，需要專業統計知識。

blocks.en: The brief introductions given below are primarily meant to help understanding papers where these methods have been applied. For a more in-depth discussion, see, e.g. Therneau and Grambsch (2000).
blocks.zh: 以下簡介的主要目的，是協助讀者理解採用這些方法的論文。更深入的討論，可參考 Therneau 與 Grambsch（2000）等文獻。

blocks.en: 6.4.1 Multi-State Models The methodology of multi-state models (Putter et al. 2007) has been developed to understand the interplay between different clinical events and interventions after HCT and their impact on subsequent prognosis. Their primary advantage is that sequences of events, such as HCT, DLI, GVHD and death, and competing events, such as relapse and NRM, can be modelled simultaneously (see Fig. 6.2 for an example). This is in contrast to analysing composite survival outcomes such as GVHD-free survival where all failures are combined and resolution of GVHD is not considered. Some studies applying this method that offer new insights into the outcomes after HCT are Klein et al. ( 2000) about current leukaemia-free survival, Iacobelli et al. ( 2015) about the role of second HCT and CR for MM patients and Eefting et al. ( 2016) about the evaluation of a TCD-based strategy incorporating DLI for AML patients.
blocks.zh: 〔6.4.1 多狀態模型 Multi-state models〕這類方法的發展，旨在了解 HCT 後不同臨床事件與介入措施之間的交互關係，及其對後續預後的影響（Putter 等，2007）。其主要優點，是可同時建模事件序列，例如 HCT、DLI、GVHD 與死亡，以及復發與 NRM 等競爭事件（圖6.2）。這不同於 GVHD-free survival 等複合存活終點：後者將所有失敗事件合併，卻不考慮 GVHD 之後可能緩解。運用此方法而提供 HCT 結果新見解的研究，包括 Klein 等（2000）對「目前白血病無病存活」的分析、Iacobelli 等（2015）對 MM 患者第二次 HCT 及 CR 角色的研究，以及 Eefting 等（2016）對結合 DLI 的 TCD 策略用於 AML 患者之評估。

blocks.en: 6.4.2 Random Effect Models In standard methods, all patients are considered as independent, and each patient only contributes one observation for each endpoint. There are, however, situations when this does not hold, for instance, when patients within the same centre tend to have more similar outcomes than those from another centre or when one patient can experience more than one outcome of the same kind, e.g. infections. In these cases, the outcomes within one ‘cluster’ (a centre or a patient) are more correlated than the outcomes between clusters, which has to be accounted for in the analysis. This is usually done by random effect models, which assume that each cluster shares an unobserved random effect. In survival analysis, these are called frailty models (Therneau and Grambsch 2000, Chap. 9). If the outcome is not an event but a value measured over time, e.g. CD8 counts, the appropriate regression models are mixed models and joint models (Baart et al. 2021).
blocks.zh: 〔6.4.2 隨機效應模型 Random-effect models〕標準方法把所有患者視為彼此獨立，每名患者對每個終點只提供一個觀察值。然而，有些情況並不符合此假設：例如同一中心的患者結果，可能比不同中心的患者更相似；或者同一患者可能重複發生同一類結果，例如感染。在這些情境中，同一「群集」（中心或患者）內的結果，比不同群集之間更相關，分析時必須加以考慮。通常會使用 random-effect models，假設每個群集共享一個未被觀察到的隨機效應。在存活分析中，這稱為 frailty models（Therneau 與 Grambsch，2000，第9章）。若結果不是事件，而是隨時間量測的數值，例如 CD8 計數，則適當的迴歸方法包括 mixed models 與 joint models（Baart 等，2021）。

blocks.en: 6.4.3 Long-Term Outcomes: Relative Survival/Cure Models With improved long-term outcomes and increasing numbers of older patients, a substantial number of patients will die from other causes than the disease for which they have been transplanted and the direct and indirect consequences of its treatment. This so-called population mortality can be quantified by methods from relative survival, using population tables describing mortality of the general population (Pohar Perme et al. 2016).
blocks.zh: 〔6.4.3 長期結果：相對存活／治癒模型〕隨著長期結果改善及高齡患者增加，相當一部分患者的死因，既不是當初接受移植的疾病，也不是其治療的直接或間接後果。這類「人口死亡率」（population mortality），可利用描述一般人口死亡率的生命表，以 relative survival 方法加以量化（Pohar Perme 等，2016）。

blocks.en: Fig. 6.2 Example of a multi-state model. All patients start in state 1 (event-free after HCT). They can then proceed through the states by different routes. Each arrow indicates a possible transition. Figure states: Auto SCT; Allo SCT; aGvHD; cGvHD; Death.
blocks.zh: 【圖6.2】多狀態模型的例子。所有患者從狀態1開始，也就是 HCT 後尚未發生事件；之後可沿不同途徑進入其他狀態，每一個箭頭代表一種可能的狀態轉移。圖中狀態標籤：Auto SCT＝自體移植；Allo SCT＝異體移植；aGvHD＝急性 GVHD；cGvHD＝慢性 GVHD；Death＝死亡。

blocks.en: Especially for transplanted children, a period with a high risk of mortality can be followed by a very long and stable period where the death risk is (almost) zero. When the focus of an analysis is on the probability of long-term cure, cure models can be used that assess the impact of risk factors on this but only if follow-up is sufficiently long (Sposto 2002).
blocks.zh: 對接受移植的兒童尤其如此：一段死亡風險較高的時期後，可能接著出現非常長且穩定、死亡風險接近零的階段。若分析重點是長期治癒的機率，可用 cure models 評估風險因子對此機率的影響，但前提是追蹤時間必須足夠長（Sposto，2002）。

blocks.en: 6.4.4 Propensity Scores Propensity scores (PS) are useful to compare the outcomes of two treatments in the absence of randomization, to control confounding due to the fact that usually the choice of the treatment depends on patient’s characteristics (confounding by indication) (Rosenbaum and Rubin 1983).
blocks.zh: 〔6.4.4 傾向分數 Propensity scores〕在未經隨機分派的情況下，PS 可用於比較兩種治療結果，以控制因治療選擇通常取決於病人特徵而產生的混雜，也就是 confounding by indication（Rosenbaum 與 Rubin，1983）。

blocks.en: First, the PS, defined as the probability of receiving one treatment instead of the other, is estimated for each patient. Then PS can be used in various ways (mainly stratification or pair matching), allowing comparison of treatment outcomes among cases with a similar risk profile.
blocks.zh: 首先，為每名患者估計 PS，定義為接受某一治療、而非另一治療的機率。之後可用不同方式運用 PS，主要包括分層或成對配對，使風險輪廓相近的個案之間，可以比較治療結果。

blocks.en: 6.4.5 Methods for Missing Values Missing values in risk predictors are a common problem in clinical studies. The simplest solution is to exclude the patients with missing values from the analysis (CC [complete case analysis]).
blocks.zh: 〔6.4.5 缺失值的處理方法〕臨床研究中，風險預測變項有缺失值是常見問題。最簡單的解法，是將有缺失值的患者排除於分析之外，稱為 complete-case analysis（CC）。

blocks.en: This solution is not optimal, however: firstly, not all information is used (an excluded patient might have other characteristics known), and secondly, this approach can lead to bias if patients with missing values have on average a different outcome from the patients with observed values.
blocks.zh: 然而，這並非最佳方法。第一，沒有使用所有資訊：被排除的患者，其他特徵可能仍是已知的。第二，若有缺失值的患者，其平均結果與資料完整者不同，這種方法就可能產生偏差。

blocks.en: If values can be imputed on the basis of observed values in the dataset, these patients can be retained in the analysis to increase precision of estimates and (under certain conditions) avoid bias. The replacement of all missing values of a variable by a single value, e.g. its mean or mode if categorical, should be avoided; instead multiple imputation (MI) can be used. MICE (White et al. 2011) is the most common approach for MI; another method to consider more suitable for Cox models is called SMC-FCS (Bartlett et al. 2015). A major advantage of MI is that it properly takes into account the uncertainty caused by the imputation in the estimates. For practical advice on when and how to use MI, see Carpenter and Smuk (2021). If data are missing not at random—meaning their values cannot be predicted from the observed variables—multiple imputation can at most decrease the bias but not fully remove it.
blocks.zh: 若可根據資料集中已觀察到的數值填補缺失值，就能將這些患者保留在分析中，提高估計精確度，並在某些條件下避免偏差。不應把某變項所有缺失值一律替換成同一個數值，例如平均數，或類別變項的眾數；可改用 multiple imputation（MI，多重插補）。MICE 是最常見的 MI 方法（White 等，2011）；另一個值得考慮、對 Cox models 更合適的方法，稱為 SMC-FCS（Bartlett 等，2015）。MI 的主要優點，是在估計中適當納入插補造成的不確定性。何時及如何使用 MI 的實務建議，可參考 Carpenter 與 Smuk（2021）。若資料屬 missing not at random，也就是無法根據已觀察變項預測其缺失值，則多重插補最多只能減少偏差，無法完全消除偏差。

blocks.en: Key Points: Survival and competing risk endpoints need specific methods. Survival analysis methods: Kaplan-Meier, log-rank test and Cox model. Competing risks methods: cumulative incidence curve, Gray test, Cox model and Fine and Gray model. Including events/changes of status occurring during follow-up in an analysis requires specific (advanced) methods, like multi-state models.
blocks.zh: 【章末重點】① 存活終點與競爭風險終點，需要使用各自適當的方法。② 存活分析方法包括 Kaplan–Meier、log-rank test 與 Cox model。③ 競爭風險方法包括累積發生率曲線、Gray test、Cox model 與 Fine–Gray model。④ 若要將追蹤期間才發生的事件或狀態變化納入分析，需要特定的進階方法，例如 multi-state models。
